alignment.note: A FAIL locus must be reported as 'Fail', never as susceptible. Duplicates are marked, not removed.

calling.large_deletion_rejection_rule: kept only if PRECISE (split reads) and depth inside the interval <= 10% of the genome mean (PLACEHOLDER)
calling.note: Calls seen below the AF limit are reported as sub-clonal; thresholds are PLACEHOLDERS.

cards.synthesis: A 6,009 bp deletion (2,283,772-2,289,780, H37Rv NC_000962.3) removes 95% of Rv2038c, 100% of Rv2039c, 100% of Rv2040c, 100% of Rv2041c, 100% of Rv2042c, 100% of pncA, 100% of Rv2044c, 6% of lipT. TnSeq essentiality in vitro: non-essential: Rv2038c, Rv2039c, Rv2040c, Rv2041c, Rv2042c, pncA, Rv2044c, lipT. WHO catalogue v2: Pyrazinamide group 2, Assoc w R - Interim (pncA_deletion). Structural and evolutionary context only; it does not change the WHO catalogue call.
